subject: Re: Dedicated packaging & isolation — pricing, SKUs, and compliance add-ons
messages:
From: Claire D'Souza <claire@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated deployment + single-tenant security add-ons — initial ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the intro last week. We're sizing a Dedicated (single-tenant) deployment to support our payments risk models and have a few procurement/architecture questions before we go deeper:

- Can you provide a line-item estimate (monthly) for reserved commits at 8x A100-equivalent GPUs vs. 16x?
- What does Redwood charge on top for single-tenant isolation (VPC, dedicated GPU pool, tenant network isolation)? We need the surcharge broken out from base reserved pricing.
- We're required to bring our own KMS (AWS KMS) for key management. Does that reduce the KMS add-on fee? Pricing for envelope encryption and key rotation audit logs?
- Audit logging: how long are logs retained by default and what are the retention-tier costs?
- Throughput SLOs: what throughput guarantees come with 99.9% uptime vs. 99.95%? Any credits/backoff?

We're targeting a start-of-prod in Q3 and would like a preliminary commercial terms sheet + any standard security annex. Procurement will want to see a 24-month commit option if that yields material discounts.

Appreciate it — Claire

--
Claire D'Souza
Head of Infrastructure
FintechCo
claire@fintechco.com
[Attachment: requirements_fintechco_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment + single-tenant security add-ons — initial ask

Claire — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR: we can support your requirements; see attached pricing pack and security annex. Key points below and a suggested next step (30–45 minute commercial call).

Quick answers:
- Reserved commit (estimate): 8x A100 equiv: $78,000/mo base; 16x: $148,000/mo base (these are committed reserved capacity rates before add-ons).
- Single-tenant isolation premium: typically 18–24% of base reserved price depending on network isolation depth and whether you want physical tenancy vs logical isolation.
- KMS: if you bring your own AWS KMS, we remove the managed-KMS line item (one-time connector + monthly per-GPU key rotation processing fee still applies).
- Audit logs: default 90-day retention. Extended tiers: 1 year and 3 years at $0.015/GB-month and $0.045/GB-month respectively after the included allowance.
- Throughput SLOs: 99.9% latency SLO (p95 < 120ms) on committed capacity; 99.95% requires a higher committed buffer and ~6–8% uplift in price. Credits scale by downtime and are capped per SLA.

Attached: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf (summary), SLA_and_Security_Annex.docx (security terms + SOC2 statements).

If you can share target QPS and average sequence length we can produce a throughput-runbook and a more accurate CPU/GPU sizing + burst-capacity estimate. I'm free Wed/Thu afternoon.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

[Attachment: SLA_and_Security_Annex.docx (DOCX, 220KB)]

From: Claire D'Souza <claire@fintechco.com>

Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment + single-tenant security add-ons — initial ask

Ben,

Thanks — that's a helpful start. A few follow-ups so we can run this through procurement:

1) Can you provide a line-by-line breakdown that shows: base reserved price, isolation premium (network + GPU pool), one-time onboarding, KMS connector fee (one-time + monthly), audit log baseline allowance and overage rates? Procurement wants to see the starting ARR and the breakouts.
2) For KMS: we'll use AWS KMS. If Redwood doesn't touch keys (BYOK), can you drop the monthly KMS processing fee entirely and just charge the integration one-time connector cost?
3) For the SLA uplift: you mention a 6–8% uplift for 99.95% — can you show an example calculation for our 16x config and include the dollar figure for credits (how they're calculated)?
4) Burst: sometimes we need 2x capacity for short windows (20–60 mins). Do you support burst billing (pay-as-you-go) vs committing to a larger base? Any enforced minimums for bursts?

Procurement is open to a 24-month commit if we can get a 10–15% discount off combined base + isolation premium and waiver of the onboarding fee for enterprise contracts. Is that within reach?

Claire

--
Claire D'Souza
Head of Infrastructure, FintechCo

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment + single-tenant security add-ons — initial ask

Claire — thanks, putting some line-item detail here (summary view). I'll upload a worked spreadsheet to the MRP link after this message.

Pricing example (monthly pricing, USD) — 16x A100-equivalent reserved commit
- Base reserved price: $148,000
- Single-tenant isolation premium (network + dedicated GPU pool): +22% => $32,560
- One-time onboarding & infra validation (amortized monthly over 12 months): $9,000/mo (one-time fee is $108k)
- KMS connector: one-time integration $12,000; monthly key-rotation processing (if RDW manages rotation): $1,200/mo. If customer BYOK and RDW performs zero key operations, we waive the monthly processing fee and only charge the connector.
- Audit logging: includes 500GB/mo baseline @ no charge. Overage: $0.015/GB-month (1yr tier) or $0.045/GB-month (3yr tier) for longer retention.
- Throughput SLA uplift (to 99.95%): +7% on combined base+isolation => $12,884/mo uplift. SLA credit calculation: pro-rata on unrecoverable downtime above SLA threshold; credit limited to monthly committed spend for that service.

Options for burst: we offer burst capacity by the minute using a pre-warmed pool. Billing for burst is metered at 1.6x the equivalent committed per-GPU minute rate; no long-term minimum but bursts require a 30-minute prewarm window for large (>2x) events.

Discounting: for a 24-month committed ARR we can offer a blended discount if you commit to 16x for 24 months: 12% off base + 50% of onboarding fee waived (i.e., $54k waived). We can push to 15% off combined base+isolation if legal accepts a standard revenue-share clause and minimum annual usage floors. Ben will follow up on specific quote language.

Next steps:
- I'll upload pricing_breakdown_calc.xlsx to the portal and share the MAP link (https://redwood.app/mutual-action-plan/DEAL-2026-047).
- Schedule 45-min call to finalize the commercial term sheet and agree a pilot scope (4-week pilot with capped burst).

Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Laura / Ben — this is very helpful and close to what procurement needs. Two quick items before we lock: 

1) Commercial ask: FintechCo would accept a 24-month 16x commit if Redwood can provide a 15% discount on combined base + isolation premium (not the SLA uplift) and fully waive onboarding (we prefer no upfront capital). The trade is a strict annual usage floor and a statement of work for the pilot baked into the MSA.

2) Security/ops ask: we will BYOK via AWS KMS — can you confirm in writing that Redwood will not hold or have access to customer master keys and that monthly key-rotation processing fees will be waived in that case? Procurement will request that in the security annex.

If you can accept the 15% + waive onboarding we can move NDA/legal review this week and route to procurement for PO prep.
